To wire electrical outlet, follow these steps:

1. Turn off power to outlet. Check with voltage tester. If tester show voltage, turn off power at circuit breaker or fuse box.
2. Remove cover plate. Use screwdriver to remove screws holding cover plate. Set aside.
3. Remove outlet. Use screwdriver to remove screws holding outlet to box. Pull outlet out of box.
4. Check wiring. Look at wiring in outlet. There should be two black wires, one white wire, and one ground wire. Black wires connect to black wires, white wires connect to white wires, ground wires connect to ground.
5. Connect new wiring. If you want to add more outlets, connect new wiring to existing wiring. Use wire nuts to connect wires. Twist wires together, then twist wire nuts clockwise to secure.
6. Install new outlet. Put new outlet into box. Connect wires to outlet. Use wire nuts to connect wires. Twist wires together, then twist wire nuts clockwise to secure.
7. Replace cover plate. Put cover plate back on outlet. Screw it in place.
8. Turn power back on. Use voltage tester to make sure power is off. Turn power back on at circuit breaker or fuse box.
